item.title: Buchla 02 Vibrations
item.description: video upload by Deep Forest "A deep dive into the Buchla universe. Modular synthesis, unstable voltages, organic shapes. Living sounds, unpredictable, born from analog circuits and raw vibrations. Nothing is fixed here: the sound breathes, evolves, transforms. An exploration of the Buchla as a true instrument, somewhere between sonic matter and experimental music."

item.title: Scale Snap - Eurorack Random Note CV Sequencer
item.description: video upload by HOX808 "Scale Snap generates random but scale-accurate note patterns of up to 16 steps. You choose the key/scale, root note, number of steps, and how “jumpy” the pattern feels. It also includes a chord/'Strainer' mode that locks notes to triad tones (random-only, ascending, or descending). Connections include clock in, 1V/Oct CV out (0–5V), reset to step 1, and a random trigger/
